title: Time Series Analysis in Frequency Domain: A Survey of Open Challenges, Opportunities and Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2504.07099v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Frequency-domain analysis has emerged as a powerful paradigm for time series analysis, offering unique advantages over traditional time-domain approaches while introducing new theoretical and practical challenges. This survey provides a comprehensive examination of spectral methods from classical Fourier analysis to modern neural operators, systematically summarizing three open challenges in current research: (1) causal structure preservation during spectral transformations, (2) uncertainty quantification in learned frequency representations, and (3) topology-aware analysis for non-Euclidean data structures. Through rigorous reviewing of over 100 studies, we develop a unified taxonomy that bridges conventional spectral techniques with cutting-edge machine learning approaches, while establishing standardized benchmarks for performance evaluation. translated_title: 频域时间序列分析：开放挑战、机遇与基准的综述
translated_abstract: 频域分析已成为时间序列分析的一种强大范式，相较于传统时域方法具有独特优势，同时也带来了新的理论与实践挑战。本综述对谱方法进行了全面考察，涵盖从经典傅里叶分析到现代神经算子的各类方法，系统总结了当前研究中的三大开放挑战：(1) 谱变换过程中的因果结构保持，(2) 学习到的频率表示的不确定性量化，(3) 面向非欧几里得数据结构的拓扑感知分析。通过对100多项研究的严格审查，我们建立了一个统一的分类体系，将传统谱技术与前沿机器学习方法相衔接，并建立了标准化的性能评估基准。我们的工作识别了该领域的关键知识空白，特别是在几何深度学习相关方向。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了从经典傅里叶分析到现代神经算子的频域时间序列分析方法，构建了统一分类体系与标准化基准，并指出了因果结构保持、不确定性量化和拓扑感知分析三大开放挑战。
